verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerting lets users define rules: NRQL-based conditions, thresholds or anomaly detection on any signal, plus who is notified and how. When a rule fires, issues are routed automatically to systems or teams. The only documented automatic actions, however, are notifications and routing, along with a security-specific agent that can open Jira or GitHub issues. Missing for 10: documented general-purpose event-triggered actions beyond notifications (e.g. workflow or remediation actions), detail on action types and integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You define the data to watch, the thresholds that if exceeded mean an issue, who is notified, and how.
